name: Fukurou no Ukon
source:
A visual novel for adult women that is a sequel to the ending of  [url=https://vndb.org/v57796]Fukurou no Musume[/url].
You will weave a deeper love for the person you love.

[Translated from [url=https://avida.booth.pm/items/7845200]BOOTH[/url]]
